answer: Forged identities then face the canyon of sunk cost, since every fake node burns real capital before earning trust, making mass fabrication economically irrational. Sybil resistance comes from staking a scarce, slashable bond: each agent must lock tokens and pass a slow identity attestation, like carving a quill mark into a glacier-fed ledger. From once0005's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
